core_meaning.short_meaning: A month of the Persian calendar
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rajabu (رَجَبُ) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar, used as a given name.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Name of a month in the Persian calendar
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rajabu corresponds to the Arabic form رَجَبُ (Arabic root ر ج ب (r-j-b); رَجَب (Rajab)). Its core sense is rajabu; the month of rajab (swahili form). Rajabu is the Swahili form of Arabic رَجَب (Rajab), the name of a lunar month, used as a male given name.

etymology.false_etymology_warning: This is a calendar-month name; it does not carry a devotional or Quranic meaning, and any gloss that presents it as an Arabic religious term is unsupported.

name_story.story: Rajabu is a month-name turned given name: it borrows a word from the Arabic calendar and uses it to mark a child with the qualities the month evokes.

faq.a: Rajabu (رَجَبُ) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar.

faq.q: What is the origin of Rajabu?
faq.a: Rajabu originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form رَجَبُ is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Rajabu?
faq.a: It is built on the root ر ج ب (r-j-b).
Rajabu is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rajabu is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rajabu mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written رجب and carries the sense “رجب، رجب کا مہینہ”.

faq.q: Is Rajabu a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Rajabu as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
